# Savewave

> Savewave is a privacy-focused universal media downloader created by Kuber Bassi.

Savewave provides a simple workflow:

Paste → Resolve → Save

## Features

- Automatic media source detection
- Automatic best available quality selection
- Video and audio handling where supported
- No user accounts
- No database
- Local browser history
- No permanent server-side media storage
- Stateless media resolution where possible

## Supported Sources

- YouTube (videos, Shorts, audio)
- Instagram (Reels, posts, videos, images, carousels, Stories)
- Facebook (videos, Reels, public post media)
- Threads (public images, public videos)
- X / Twitter (videos, images)
- SoundCloud (audio)
- Spotify (metadata + Smart Match audio source)
- Direct Media (MP4, WebM, MP3, M4A, AAC, OGG, WAV, FLAC, JPG, PNG, WebP)

## Privacy

Savewave does not require user accounts or a database.

Download history is stored locally on the user's device.

Media is not permanently stored by Savewave servers.

Media is downloaded directly from its source when technically supported.
